Also get these (from a local shop)

  • 2 empty spray bottles (500 ml). One for "CLEANER STRONG", one for "CLEANER LIGHT".
  • 3 buckets (big, 15–20 litres).
  • 1 soft brush for tyres.
  • Marker pen and tape to write names on bottles.
  • Rubber gloves.
  • One empty 1 litre water bottle to measure water.
TIP: mark your bucketsPour the 1 litre bottle of water into a bucket 10 times. Draw a line at the water top. Write "10 L". Do this on Bucket 1 and Bucket 2.

How to mix

Use the measuring cup from the glass cleaner box.

Foam Blaster

100 ml Foam Blaster + 900 ml water

In the 1 litre foam bottle on the pressure washer.

Big foam tank? Use 50 ml for every 1 litre of water. Example: 4 litres water + 200 ml.

Wonder Wash or Wash and Wax

30 ml shampoo + 10 litres water

In Bucket 1. Water first, then shampoo. Mix with your hand.

Big SUV: 40 ml.

All Purpose Cleaner (STRONG)

80 ml cleaner + 420 ml water

In spray bottle 1. Write CLEANER STRONG. For tyres, wheels, mats.

All Purpose Cleaner (LIGHT)

25 ml cleaner + 475 ml water

In spray bottle 2. Write CLEANER LIGHT. For door edges.

Glass Cleaner

25 ml glass liquid + 475 ml water

In the spray bottle that came in the glass box.

Use clean drinking (RO) water for best glass.

NO MIXING NEEDEDTyre Guard · Dashboard Shiner · Spray Wax · PLVR · Glass Shield. Use them straight from the bottle.

Get ready (before the first car)

  1. Pick a place with shade.
  2. Bucket 1: water to the 10 L line + 30 ml shampoo.
  3. Bucket 2: water to the 10 L line. Nothing else.
  4. Bucket 3: water. Only for the tyre brush.
  5. Fill the foam bottle (100 ml Foam Blaster + 900 ml water).
  6. Fill the CLEANER STRONG, CLEANER LIGHT and glass spray bottles.
  7. Put all cloths in a clean box. Not on the floor.
  8. Phone ready for photos.

The 18 steps

3 RULES1. Work in the shade.  2. Water and washing: roof first, bottom last.  3. Never rub a car that still has sand on it.
1

Car comes. Say hello. Take photos.

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM3 min
  1. Say: "Good morning. I'm [name] from Mana Wash."
  2. Ask: Express, Basic or Premium?
  3. Walk around the car with the customer. Show any old scratch.
  4. Take 4 photos: front, back, left, right.
  5. Ask them to take out money and phones.
CAREFUL
  • No photos = no wash. Old scratches can become your problem.
2

Park the car

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM2 min
  1. Park in the shade.
  2. Engine off.
  3. Close all windows.
  4. Touch the bonnet. Hot? Wait 10 minutes.
  5. Take out the floor mats.
3

Clean the mats

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM3 min
USE
  1. Rubber mats: spray CLEANER STRONG.
  2. Scrub with the brush.
  3. Wash with water. Stand them up to dry.
  4. Cloth mats: shake hard. Vacuum later.
4

Clean tyres and wheels (first!)

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM5–7 min
USE
  1. Wear gloves.
  2. One wheel at a time.
  3. Spray water on the wheel.
  4. Spray CLEANER STRONG on the tyre and wheel.
  5. Wait 30 seconds.
  6. Scrub with the brush. Brown foam is good. It is old dirt.
  7. Wash it off with water.
  8. Dip the brush in Bucket 3. Next wheel.
CAREFUL
  • Don't let the cleaner dry in the sun.
  • Don't use the tyre brush on the paint.
WATCH VIDEO
  • Wavex All Purpose Cleaner review YouTube
  • Cleaning tyres with a degreaser: spray, scrub, rinse YouTube
5

Spray water on the whole car

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM3 min

Use: pressure washer, water only.

  1. Stand 1–2 feet away (one arm).
  2. Order: Roof → Glass → Bonnet → Doors → Bottom.
  3. Spray well under the wheel area.
CAREFUL
  • Don't go too close.
  • Don't spray hard on stickers.
6

Spray foam on the whole car

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM3 min + wait 3–5 min
USE
  1. Put the foam bottle on the pressure washer gun.
  2. Spray foam from the bottom of the car, up to the roof.
  3. Cover the whole car in white foam.
  4. Wait 3–5 minutes. Dirty foam slides down slowly.
CAREFUL
  • Don't let the foam dry.
  • Not in hot sun.
WATCH VIDEO
  • Wavex Foam Blaster (Wavex video) YouTube
  • Foam Blaster review YouTube
7

Wash off the foam

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM3 min

Use: pressure washer, water only.

  1. Normal water nozzle.
  2. Order: Roof → Glass → Bonnet → Doors → Bottom.
  3. Until no foam is left.

Now most of the sand is gone. The car is safe to touch.

8

Wash by hand (2 buckets)

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM8–12 min
USE
Bucket 1

10 L water + 30 ml shampoo

Bucket 2

Clean water only

  1. Dip the mitt in Bucket 1 (shampoo).
  2. Wash a small part of the car. Move in straight lines. Press softly.
  3. Dip the mitt in Bucket 2. Squeeze it. (Dirt stays in Bucket 2.)
  4. Go back to Bucket 1. Wash the next part.
  5. Order: Roof → Glass → Bonnet → Boot → Top of doors → Bottom of doors → Bumpers.
CAREFUL
  • Mitt falls down? Stop. Wash it well first.
  • No circles. No pressing hard.
  • Bubbles in the bucket are good. Don't add extra shampoo.
WATCH VIDEO
  • Two-bucket wash, 7 easy steps YouTube
  • Wavex Wonder Wash review (Hindi) YouTube
  • Wavex Wash and Wax YouTube
9

Wash off the shampoo

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM3 min

Use: pressure washer, water only.

  1. Order: Roof → Glass → Bonnet → Doors → Bottom.
  2. Also inside the fuel lid, around mirrors and the front grille.
  3. Until no shampoo is left.
10

Dry the car

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM5–7 min
USE

Also use: big Flash Dry towel.

  1. Open the big towel. Lay it flat on the roof.
  2. Hold 2 corners. Pull it slowly towards you. Don't rub.
  3. Do: Roof → Glass → Bonnet → Boot → Sides.
  4. Open each door. Spray a little CLEANER LIGHT on the door edges. Wipe with the grey cloth.
  5. Wipe water drips from mirrors and handles.
CAREFUL
  • Never let the car dry by itself. It leaves white spots.
WATCH VIDEO
  • How to dry a car with a microfibre towel YouTube
  • Fast drying without scratches (short) YouTube
11

Wax the paint

PREMIUM8–12 min
USE
  1. One part at a time: bonnet, then roof, then one door.
  2. Spray 2–3 times on the part.
  3. Spread with the grey sponge. Straight lines.
  4. Rub with the black towel until it shines.
  5. Next part.
  6. Not on glass. Not on black rough plastic.
CAREFUL
  • Too much wax = greasy lines. 2–3 sprays is enough.
WATCH VIDEO
  • Wavex Spray Wax review YouTube
  • Car spray wax (Wavex) YouTube
12

Clean the glass

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM4 min
USE
  1. Outside: spray on the glass.
  2. Wipe with the kit towel.
  3. Wipe again with the dry Ultra Wipe until it shines. No lines.
  4. Inside (Basic and Premium): spray on the towel, not on the glass. Wipe. Then Ultra Wipe.
  5. Also do the mirrors.
CAREFUL
  • Not in hot sun (lines come).
  • Never use grey or yellow cloths on glass.
13

Glass Shield on the front glass

PREMIUM5 min
USE
  1. Front glass must be clean and dry.
  2. Put a few drops on the kit towel.
  3. Rub on the outside of the front glass. Small circles.
  4. Wait 2–3 minutes (it looks a little cloudy).
  5. Wipe with the Ultra Wipe until clear.
CAREFUL
  • Outside only. Never inside.
  • For 1–2 days the wipers may jump a little. Normal.
WATCH VIDEO
  • Wavex Glass Shield Pro YouTube
  • Glass Shield Pro: water beading YouTube
14

Shine the tyres

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM3 min
USE
  1. Tyre must be dry.
  2. Spray Tyre Guard on the black sponge.
  3. Wipe on the side of the tyre only.
  4. Some on the wheel or paint? Wipe it off with the grey cloth.
CAREFUL
  • Never on the part of the tyre that touches the road. It becomes slippery.
WATCH VIDEO
  • How to use Wavex Tyre Guard YouTube
15

Vacuum inside

BASICPREMIUM6–10 min

Use: vacuum cleaner.

  1. Take out rubbish (ask the customer first).
  2. Seats first. Then the floor.
  3. Push seats forward. Clean behind. Push back. Clean in front.
  4. Clean the boot and the cloth mats.
16

Clean inside (deep)

PREMIUM12–15 min
USE
  1. Spray PLVR on a yellow cloth. Not on the dashboard.
  2. Wipe: dashboard, steering, gear, doors, handles.
  3. Leather seats: spray on the cloth. Wipe softly.
  4. Dry it with the second yellow cloth.
WATCH VIDEO
  • Wavex PLVR interior cleaner YouTube
17

Shine the dashboard

BASICPREMIUM4 min
USE
  1. Basic: first wipe the dust with a dry yellow cloth.
  2. Spray Dashboard Shiner on the yellow round sponge.
  3. Wipe: dashboard, centre, door panels.
  4. Wipe once with a dry cloth, so it is not oily.
CAREFUL
  • Never on the steering wheel, pedals or gear knob. They become slippery.
  • Never on screens or glass.
WATCH VIDEO
  • Wavex Dashboard Shiner YouTube
18

Check and give the car

EXPRESSBASICPREMIUM3–5 min
  1. Put the mats back.
  2. Walk around the car slowly. Look for: water drops, foam, lines on glass, shine on wheels.
  3. Look inside: dust, wet spots, customer's things.
  4. Take 4 "after" photos.
  5. Show the car to the customer. Walk around together.
  6. Say: "Your car is ready. Please rate us on WhatsApp. Thank you!"
  7. Take payment. Enter it in the software.
  8. Say: "See you in 7–10 days."

After the car

After every car

  1. Grey cloths in one bucket. All other cloths in another bucket.
  2. Wash the mitt in clean water.
  3. Wash the tyre brush in Bucket 3.
  4. Change bucket water after 3–4 cars.
  5. Fill the foam bottle if low.

End of the day

  1. Wash cloths with a little soap powder. Grey cloths separately.
  2. No softener. No bleach. No iron.
  3. Dry cloths in the shade.
  4. Wash all 3 buckets.
  5. Run clean water through the foam bottle.
  6. Close all bottles. Keep away from sun and children.

Test sheet

Wash 6 cars. Write what you used after each car.

CarShampooFoam (ml)Shampoo (ml)MinutesGood or bad?
1Wonder Wash
2Wash and Wax
3Wonder Wash
4Wash and Wax
5Wonder Wash
6Wash and Wax
  • Foam thick? Stays 3–5 minutes?
  • Mitt slides easily?
  • White spots after drying?
  • Which shampoo shines more?
  • Glass: any lines?
  • Tyres and dashboard: shiny? Oily?

Safety

  • Gloves for CLEANER and Tyre Guard.
  • Liquid in the eyes: wash with clean water for 15 minutes. Then see a doctor. Take the bottle.
  • Swallowed: go to a doctor at once. Take the bottle.
  • Never point the pressure washer at a person.
  • Keep plugs and wires dry.
  • Keep bottles closed, away from sun and children.
